package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for http_response_body_not_drained_before_close: HTTP response bodies that are closed without being drained or otherwise consumed when the response is ignored.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: info.
func checkHealth(url string) error {
	resp, err := http.Get(url)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	_ = resp.StatusCode
	return nil
}

func pingEndpoint(url string) bool {
	resp, err := http.Get(url)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	return resp.StatusCode == 200
}
